title: Correct matrix
purpose: Replace a wrongly recorded matrix and all requested test definitions together before work begins.
summary: Replace a wrongly recorded matrix and all of the sample's requested tests together, before any work starts.

tasks.title: Correct the matrix
steps: Choose the [[Tests for the corrected matrix]]. They replace the current requests.

tasks.title: Restore the sample source afterwards
steps: If the source was cleared, set it again with Correct sample details.

good_to_know: Any analytical work, QC, preparation, external dispatch or issued report on the sample locks this correction.
The old tests are not mapped to the new matrix. Choose every test again.
A sample source that does not belong to the new matrix is cleared. Stormwater fits both Water and Wastewater.

sections.title: Correction sections
paragraphs: Custodians, project managers and administrators use these sections. A tab marked locked still opens to explain the blocker. The header identifies current client sample ID and client/project.

items.label: Identity, type, location
items.description: Correct client sample ID, sample type, sample source, collector, collection place and sample remarks.

items.label: Collection type and times
items.description: Correct grab/composite and its collection timestamps.

items.label: Receipt observations
items.description: Correct temperature, thermometer, coolant, custody seal, preservation observation or discrepancy.

items.label: Requested tests
items.description: Add tests or withdraw those with no dependent work.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Correct a wrong matrix and replace its requested tests together. A recorded sample source that does not belong to the new matrix is cleared.

sections.title: Fields and eligibility
paragraphs: Any internal analytical work record, parent QC record, external dispatch history including cancellation, or preparation membership including closed/cancelled work blocks matrix correction. An issued report containing the sample also blocks it. This preserves work measured/planned under the recorded matrix. The source recorded under Sample source is kept only when it belongs to the new matrix (stormwater belongs to both Water and Wastewater); otherwise it is cleared, and the history shows the old and new source. Record the right source afterwards with Correct sample details.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required different Water, Wastewater or Soil value. Keeping the current matrix is refused.

items.label: Tests for the corrected matrix
items.description: Required selection of at least one active test under an active method matching the new matrix. The current requests are replaced, not automatically mapped. Search by analyte, method/version or unit. Matrix changes retain mismatched selections for review; remove the marked options or correct Matrix before submitting.

sections.title: Saving and history
paragraphs: Physically disposed samples cannot be corrected. Saving rechecks the sample revision and eligibility. A stale form retains submitted input with an error; reload and review current receipt history before resubmitting.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required correction explanation, at most 4000 characters. It stays with actor, timestamp and old/new values.

items.label: Submit correction
items.description: Uses the page’s specific correction title. A successful save returns to the sample record. Earlier custody and issued report versions are never rewritten.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the sample without saving.

items.label: History
items.description: All receipt corrections for this sample, chronological, with reason and changed values. No corrections recorded is shown before the first correction.
